```{r}
set.seed(123)          # 为了结果可复现
n  <- 1000
m0 <- 0.5
sd0 <- 1.2

x1 <- rnorm(n, mean = m0, sd = sd0)   # x1,...,xn

m1  <- 1.1
sd1 <- 1.2

x2 <- rnorm(n, mean = m1, sd = sd1)   # x_{n+1},...,x_{2n}

beta0 <- 0.3
beta1 <- 1.7

logistic <- function(z) 1 / (1 + exp(-z))

p <- logistic(beta0 + beta1 * x1)     # 每个样本点对应一个概率 p_i
y <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = p)    # y1,...,yn (0/1)

mean(y)          # 1 的比例（大致反映整体正类概率）
head(data.frame(x = x1, p = p, y = y), 10)

```

hist(x2, breaks=40, probability=TRUE,
     main="Samples of X' ~ N(1.1,1.2)",
     xlab="x", col="lightgreen")

```{r}
# 已有：x1, x2, n, beta0, beta1
logistic <- function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))

p2 <- logistic(beta0 + beta1 * x2)
y2 <- rbinom(n, size=1, prob=p2)   # y_{n+1},...,y_{2n}

x_all <- c(x1, x2)
y_all <- c(y,  y2)
N <- length(x_all)  # = 2n

```
```{r}
# ========= Data (assume you already have x1,x2,y and created y2 above) =========
x_all <- c(x1, x2)
y_all <- c(y,  y2)
N <- length(x_all)

logistic <- function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))

# log-likelihood
loglik <- function(b0, b1, x, y){
  z <- b0 + b1 * x
  p <- logistic(z)
  eps <- 1e-12
  sum(y*log(p + eps) + (1-y)*log(1 - p + eps))
}

# gradient of log-likelihood
grad_loglik <- function(b0, b1, x, y){
  z <- b0 + b1 * x
  p <- logistic(z)
  g0 <- sum(y - p)
  g1 <- sum((y - p) * x)
  c(g0, g1)
}

# ========= Gradient Ascent =========
set.seed(1)
b0 <- 0       # starting point (you can change)
b1 <- 0
gamma <- 0.1  # step size (tune it)
max_iter <- 2000
tol <- 1e-6

use_normalized_grad <- TRUE  # as suggested by the statement

ll_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
gn_hist <- numeric(max_iter)
b_hist  <- matrix(NA, nrow=max_iter, ncol=2)

for (t in 1:max_iter){
  g <- grad_loglik(b0, b1, x_all, y_all)
  gn <- sqrt(sum(g^2))

  ll_hist[t] <- loglik(b0, b1, x_all, y_all)
  gn_hist[t] <- gn
  b_hist[t,] <- c(b0, b1)

  if (gn < tol) break

  if (use_normalized_grad){
    g <- g / (gn + 1e-12)
  }

  # update (gradient ASCENT)
  b0 <- b0 + gamma * g[1]
  b1 <- b1 + gamma * g[2]
}

Tstop <- t
ll_hist <- ll_hist[1:Tstop]
gn_hist <- gn_hist[1:Tstop]
b_hist  <- b_hist[1:Tstop,,drop=FALSE]

cat("Converged in", Tstop, "iterations\n")
cat("Estimated beta0 =", b0, "\n")
cat("Estimated beta1 =", b1, "\n")
```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))

plot(ll_hist, type="l",
     xlab="Iteration", ylab="Log-likelihood",
     main="Log-likelihood vs Iterations")

plot(gn_hist, type="l",
     xlab="Iteration", ylab="||Gradient||",
     main="Gradient Norm vs Iterations")

```

```{r}
bank <- read.csv("C:/Users/zfdnm/Documents/bank-additional.csv", sep=";")

# 选择需要的变量
data <- bank[, c("age","job","marital","duration","y")]

# 将分类变量转成 factor
data$job <- as.factor(data$job)
data$marital <- as.factor(data$marital)
data$y <- as.factor(data$y)
```
```{r}
library(caret)

set.seed(123)
folds <- createFolds(data$y, k=10, list=TRUE)
```
```{r}
library(caret)

# 确保 y 的 levels 是 no/yes，并且顺序固定
data$y <- factor(data$y, levels = c("no", "yes"))

set.seed(123)
folds <- createFolds(data$y, k = 10, list = TRUE)

false_pos <- rep(NA_real_, 10)
false_neg <- rep(NA_real_, 10)

for(i in 1:10){

  test_index <- folds[[i]]
  test_set  <- data[test_index, ]
  train_set <- data[-test_index, ]

  model <- glm(y ~ age + job + marital + duration,
               data = train_set,
               family = binomial)

  prob <- predict(model, newdata = test_set, type = "response")

  # 分类阈值（0.5 有时会导致全预测 no，可改成 0.3/0.4）
  pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, "yes", "no")
  pred <- factor(pred, levels = c("no", "yes"))   # ★ 强制 levels 对齐
  truth <- factor(test_set$y, levels = c("no", "yes"))

  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, truth, positive = "yes")

  # 安全提取（可能会出现 NA，这是正常的：某折没有某类）
  tab <- cm$table

  TP <- tab["yes","yes"]
  FP <- tab["yes","no"]
  FN <- tab["no","yes"]
  TN <- tab["no","no"]

# 安全计算（避免除以0）
false_pos[i] <- ifelse((FP+TN)==0, NA, FP/(FP+TN))
false_neg[i] <- ifelse((FN+TP)==0, NA, FN/(FN+TP))
}

false_pos
false_neg

```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))

plot(false_pos, type="b", pch=16,
     xlab="Fold", ylab="False Positive Rate",
     main="FPR across 10 folds", ylim=c(0,1))

plot(false_neg, type="b", pch=16,
     xlab="Fold", ylab="False Negative Rate",
     main="FNR across 10 folds", ylim=c(0,1))

```
